propositions: When a Jira workflow forbids a direct end-state transition (e.g., open -> done), the outbound sync fails and the ticket drifts to comment-fallback.
Recorded status hops from append-only STATUS events enable replay of intermediate transitions that the workflow allows, instead of failing on the direct path.
Replay resumes at the current Jira status by matching it directly in Jira-name space against the forward-mapped hop sequence, anchoring on the last occurrence when duplicates exist.
Replay aborts and falls through to comment-fallback if any intermediate hop raises RuntimeError (Cloud), ValueError/IllegalTransitionError (DC), or HTTPError.
The replay call is integrated into _update_one_scalar_update by widening the exception handler and threading local_id through the call chain without altering update_one's signature or callers.
